title: ULTIMATE Infinite String Farm In Minecraft 1.21 & Above!
description:
In this tutorial, I’ll show you how to build the next generation of string farming in Minecraft. This farm is 100% mob based and it using spawning platforms to spawn spiders and get spiders into the chambers also it's tweaked to be one hit even with a wooden sword so it can be extremely fast which makes this farm the first fastest, cheapest and 100% mob based string spider farm ever made in minecraft!

We’ll walk step by step through the process to make sure you can build it easily in your own world!
